exposure: accompaniment by a companion of choice during labor
cohort: 1660 women giving birth in Chilean public hospital facilities
finding: Maternal patient satisfaction was negatively affected by caesarean birth, pharmacologic pain management, continuous fetal heart rate monitoring, and episiotomy, while it was positively associated with accompaniment by a companion of choice during labor.
mod_finding: Caesarean birth was associated with lower satisfaction with labor and birth care.
